name: brightloop-subscription-management
description: Enterprise Subscription & Recurring Billing Management System for Brightloop Software

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
